page_title: SAS 0-1 BOL | Sassuolo v Bologna 15/03/2026, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+10' There will be no more action in this match as the referee signals full time.
90+9' Tarik Muharemovic (Sassuolo) tries his luck with a shot from long distance after receiving a good pass. His poorly placed effort flies miles wide of the left post.
90+6' The free kick is delivered by Armand Lauriente (Sassuolo) but it's not one of his best and is easily cleared.
90+6' Today's referee Kevin Bonacina rightly decides to book Nadir Zortea (Bologna) for his harsh tackle.
90+5' Nadir Zortea (Bologna) delivers a poor cross from a free kick as one of the defenders comfortably clears it away.
90+5' A player from Sassuolo brings down an opponent and commits a foul. Bologna earn a free kick.
90+4' The players claim that M'Bala Nzola (Sassuolo) handled the ball and it seems they are right.
90+3' A crossfield pass from Tarik Muharemovic (Sassuolo) fails to find any of his teammates.
90' 7 additional min. will be played.
87' Lukasz Skorupski (Bologna) is writhing in pain and can now receive medical treatment after the referee signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
87' Juan Miranda (Bologna) sends a long ball across the pitch, but it misses its target.
86' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Domenico Berardi leaves the pitch and Darryl Bakola (Sassuolo) comes on.
85' Federico Bernardeschi (Bologna) attempts to find a teammate with the corner, but the effort is snuffed out by the goalkeeper.

85' Riccardo Orsolini (Bologna) produces a ferocious strike from the edge of the box. His dangerous effort towards the right post is blocked by Arijanet Muric, who pulls off a superb save to keep the ball out of the net.
84' The Bologna players are exchanging some short passes to try and open up the opposition’s defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
83' Vincenzo Italiano has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Tommaso Pobega (Bologna) replacing Simon Sohm.
82' That's the end of the game for Jens Odgaard, who is replaced by Federico Bernardeschi (Bologna).
81' Armand Lauriente (Sassuolo) makes a yard for himself on the edge of the box after picking up a pass, but produces a poor effort that sails high over the bar.
80' Kevin Bonacina interrupts the game for a tactical foul by Cristian Volpato (Sassuolo).
77' M'Bala Nzola (Sassuolo) picks up a yellow card.
77' Josh Doig (Sassuolo) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him. The ball is out of play. Sassuolo will take a throw-in.
76' M'Bala Nzola (Sassuolo) is in a clear offside position and the referee blows his whistle after the linesman raises his flag.
75' Fabio Grosso has decided to make a change. Aster Vranckx (Sassuolo) replaces Ismael Kone.
75' Substitution. Ulisses Garcia makes his way off the pitch and Josh Doig (Sassuolo) comes on as his replacement.
75' Nadir Zortea (Bologna) found some space to play in a lofted pass, but he looks disappointed as none of his teammates managed to connect with it.
74' Riccardo Orsolini (Bologna) collects a pass from the flank, looks up and fires in a goal-bound shot from the edge of the box which canons off a defender to safety.
73' Great teamplay by Sassuolo as they control the ball with a lot of short passes. Patience is the key if they want to find a gap in the defence to score.
72' Juan Miranda (Bologna) is lying on the ground after being tackled and the physio comes onto the pitch to give him medical treatment.
71' Armand Lauriente (Sassuolo) overhits the corner kick and none of his teammates can their head on it.
71' Ulisses Garcia (Sassuolo) tries to slide the ball through to a teammate but it's well blocked by a defender.
69' Sassuolo fail to score from a corner as Lukasz Skorupski (Bologna) leaps to collect the ball.
69' Domenico Berardi (Sassuolo) delivers a long ball, but it lacks enough power to reach his teammates and is intercepted by one of the defenders.
68' Bologna take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
67' The resulting set piece from Sassuolo is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
66' Bologna quickly take a corner kick with a short pass.
65' Nicolo Cambiaghi (Bologna) tries to send a pass but it's blocked.
64' The referee and one of his assistants signal for a corner kick to Sassuolo.
64' Vincenzo Italiano has decided to substitute Thijs Dallinga and he is replaced by Santiago Castro (Bologna).
63' The manager has been forced to make a substitution and the injured Nikola Moro leaves the pitch to be replaced by Remo Freuler (Bologna).
63' Nikola Moro (Bologna) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.

62' A neat pass is well received by Cristian Volpato (Sassuolo), who is lurking on the edge of the box and strikes the ball towards the left post, but the goalkeeper makes an incredible save to block his shot.
62' Sassuolo enjoy a period of possession as they are exchanging some passes and waiting for an opportunity to strike.
61' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Sassuolo comes to nothing.
59' Fabio Grosso decides to make a substitution. Andrea Pinamonti will be replaced by M'Bala Nzola (Sassuolo).
59' The referee allows time for a substitution. Nemanja Matic will be replaced by Cristian Volpato (Sassuolo).
58' The ball is out of play. A goal-scoring opportunity from a corner for Sassuolo.
56' Martin Vitik (Bologna) tackles a bit over-zealously and Kevin Bonacina blows for a foul. Sassuolo will take a free kick.
56' Ismael Kone (Sassuolo) produces a lovely ball into the penalty area but the defender manages to intercept and comfortably averts the danger.
55' A player from Bologna takes his opponent down, the referee blows his whistle for a foul. It's a free kick to Sassuolo in a dangerous position.
54' Nikola Moro (Bologna) receives a pass and decides to smash the ball from long range, but his poor effort sails high over the bar.
52' Kristian Thorstvedt (Sassuolo) makes a yard for himself on the edge of the box and produces a poor effort that sails miles wide of the left post.
51' Some great controlled play and passing in the middle of the pitch from Bologna.
48' Nemanja Matic (Sassuolo) attempts to find his teammate with a pass from outside the box, but the opposition's defence is quick to react and thwarts the attack.
47' Nemanja Matic (Sassuolo) tries to create a chance, but puts too much weight on his pass.
46' Ulisses Garcia (Sassuolo) fails to send a pass into the box as his effort is cut out. The ball is behind the touchline and Bologna will take a throw-in.
46' The game restarts for the second half.
45+3' That is it for the first half after the referee blows his whistle and the players head to their respective dressing rooms.
45+2' Riccardo Orsolini (Bologna) shows off his skills with a mazy run to the edge of the box and then fires in a disappointing shot that flies high over the bar.
45+1' Bologna have been awarded a corner kick.
45+1' A cross into the box from Nicolo Cambiaghi (Bologna) is cleared.
45' 2 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
44' Riccardo Orsolini (Bologna) plays in a hopeful cross, but it doesn't find its way to any of the attacking players.
43' Armand Lauriente (Sassuolo) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Bologna.
43' Sassuolo are bossing possession at the moment by exchanging some precise passes from player to player.
41' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by Sassuolo, is overhit and the ball goes out of play.
38' The free kick from a promising distance is taken by Nikola Moro (Bologna), who fires in a direct effort just wide of the left post. What a chance!
37' One of the Sassuolo players tripped an opponent and conceded a foul. It's a free kick to Bologna, but it's in no position for a direct shot on goal.
36' Nikola Moro (Bologna) was standing in a clear offside position, making it an easy call for the linesman.
36' Riccardo Orsolini (Bologna) fizzes over a cross which doesn't cause any problems.
35' One of the defenders reacts at the last minute to brilliantly block a pass from Nemanja Matic (Sassuolo).
34' Armand Lauriente (Sassuolo) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
33' Another attempt to send the ball beyond the defence by Armand Lauriente (Sassuolo) is thwarted and cleared to safety.
32' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by Sassuolo, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
32' Sassuolo have been awarded a free kick. Nicolo Cambiaghi (Bologna) pulls the jersey of one of the opposition players and Kevin Bonacina blows his whistle for a foul.
31' Domenico Berardi (Sassuolo) seems to be alright and is okay to carry on.
31' Looks like Domenico Berardi (Sassuolo) is struggling after picking up a knock. Hopefully he can run it off.
30' A cross from Nicolo Cambiaghi (Bologna) fails to reach the box as the defence clears the ball away to safety.
28' Lorenzo De Silvestri is substituted due to injury. Vincenzo Italiano gives a chance to Nadir Zortea (Bologna).
27' Neat passing move from Bologna in order to create new attacking opportunities.
26' Lorenzo De Silvestri (Bologna) is asking for medical treatment after picking up an injury.
24' The whistle blows and Thijs Dallinga (Bologna) is booked for an infringement.
23' Andrea Pinamonti (Sassuolo) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.
21' Thijs Dallinga (Bologna) manages to dispossess his opponent of the ball, but he commits a foul in the process and the referee blows his whistle. Sassuolo have a free kick.
21' Armand Lauriente (Sassuolo) slides a pass forward, but one of the defenders cuts it out.
20' Sassuolo control the tempo of the game by exchanging some accurate short passes.
19' Kristian Thorstvedt (Sassuolo) swings in a cross, but the ball is cleared to safety by one of the defending players.
17' Tarik Muharemovic (Sassuolo) fails to find a teammate across the pitch with a long ball.
16' A precise low pass is received by Riccardo Orsolini (Bologna), who makes a yard for himself on the edge of the box, but his poorly placed shot sails well wide of the right post.
15' One of the Bologna players unfairly tackled his opponent and conceded a foul. Sassuolo are awarded a free kick. Let's see what they create from this.
13' The ratio of the ball possession is 37:63.

11' Armand Lauriente (Sassuolo) rifles a low drive from the edge of the box after a brilliant solo effort. The ball heads into the middle of the goal, but the goalkeeper denies him with a fantastic reflex save.
11' Juan Miranda (Bologna) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Arijanet Muric intercepts the ball.
9' Sassuolo seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. They are waiting for the right moment to create new attacking opportunities.
8' Now Sassuolo have a corner.

7' Andrea Pinamonti (Sassuolo) connected with a pass around the edge of the box, aimed and shot. His attempt went towards the left-hand post, but Lukasz Skorupski was alert and the score remains the same.

6' 0 - 1 The ball rebounds and arrives at the feet of Thijs Dallinga (Bologna) just outside the box. He doesn't think twice and fires a great shot into the bottom right corner. His attempt was beyond the reach of Arijanet Muric, so the score changes to 0:1.
5' Bologna are playing possession football and controlling the game at present. They are exchanging inch-perfect passes from player to player, making it difficult for the opposition to win the ball.
4' Armand Lauriente (Sassuolo) sends the ball into the box from the side of the pitch, but his cross is blocked.
3' The Bologna players are exchanging some short passes.
1' The first half has just begun.
Sassuolo will kick-off.
